title: The 3 Best Blackout Curtains Under $30
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for blackout curtains under $30, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blackout curtains under $30 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Grommet Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top, typically under $15, Blocks up to 90% of light, Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%.
strengths: Two panels together still cost less than most single premium panels
Genuinely reduces noise and heat, not just light
limitations: 90% blocking is a real step down from premium laminated panels at 98%+
40-inch width means most windows need at least two panels for full coverage
features: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top, typically under $15
Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%

products.name: Eclipse Darrell Rod Pocket Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 37 x 84 inch single panel, rod pocket top, typically under $25, Thermaback blackout backing, Blocks over 99% of light.
strengths: 99%+ blocking at a price close to panels that block far less
Same Thermaback backing used in Eclipse's pricier Palisade line
84-inch length fits standard-height windows without hemming
limitations: 37-inch width is narrow for a wide window, needing multiple panels
Rod pocket top is slower to adjust than a grommet panel
features: 37 x 84 inch single panel, rod pocket top, typically under $25
Reduces noise and insulates against heat and cold

products.name: Eclipse Palisade Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top, typically at or just under $25, Thermaback triple-weave blackout backing, Blocks 98% to 99.9% of light.
strengths: Standard 52-inch width fits most windows without needing three panels
Same premium Thermaback backing at a lower per-panel price than many competitors
Grommet top is easier to open and close daily than a rod pocket
limitations: Sold per panel, meaning a full pair is a separate purchase
features: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top, typically at or just under $25
Reduces outside noise and insulates against heat and cold

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
